data.one_liner: Feature flags support for Flutter applications with or without Toggly.io.
data.what_it_does: Provides feature flags support allowing you to enable and disable features in Flutter applications. It can be used with or without Toggly.io, offering features like cryptographic verification via ECDSA signed definitions and frontend telemetry.
use_when: You need to manage feature flags or toggles dynamically in a Flutter application
You want to integrate with Toggly.io for remote feature flag management
You require cryptographically signed feature flag definitions for security
avoid_when: You do not need feature flagging or remote toggling capabilities in your app
strengths: Supports both standalone usage and integration with Toggly.io
Cryptographically signed definitions using ECDSA for security
Provides built-in widgets and builders like Feature and FeatureGateBuilder
weaknesses: Requires proper key and backend configuration if using signed definitions with Toggly.io
Entity-gated flags fail closed without context
data.setup_notes: Initialize Toggly in your app startup using Toggly.init with your app key and environment.
